subject: C bag Q-SPEAR pipeline published SHA OOC 100MHz
body:
C bag: Q*/SPEAR timing pipelines PUBLISHED. CANDIDATE, not TIMING_PASS.

PUBLISHED to PACKAGE (hash == worktree, commit 7b13f64):
  4804014e0ce348ea09839b4d2e9d74ef23750f897cd21c6c6b833ccb58cd964a  rtl/native_ai/strategy/qstar_select.v
  11e71b50f64822ee7d53ab466039fc1883fa6f01c518e7aa8278ed16a3c76293  rtl/native_ai/strategy/spear_rank.v
  e3bbbf210b2a1d1a5e38a107aae497f3b7ab82819f3a050c6ef8f57c3c78038b  ref/learning/qstar_ref.py
  20fa91e30f45cad3f072460ef631a4a383a488cf7992c0ac14296058fbc1cd40  ref/learning/spear_ref.py
  f3901d09b4db736a93c3660c14e9a5b7fc94a401435752efe8c405a933865cba  ref/learning/gen_qstar_vectors.py
  f0ad479a35cf4b0b245abda7136f85b920646eb9d67111a9af04b982eb309d35  ref/learning/gen_spear_vectors.py
  (ref/gen files were the C-CODE-07 versions missing from the previous publish; vectors in PACKAGE already matched)
  rtl/native_ai/strategy/QSTAR_SPEAR_OOC_PIPE.json  (this bag as JSON)
  rtl/native_ai/strategy/ooc_100mhz/*_timing.rpt *_util.rpt *_paths.rpt

INTERFACE: no port change (spear_profile_bind.sv binds as-is). Arithmetic bit-exact, vectors unchanged.
Only extra cycles per op (S10.7 RTL_PIPELINE_DEPTH = IMPLEMENTATION_DEFINED). Use done/prop_valid handshake.

TESTS: SPEAR/QSTAR/FEM_REF_SELFTEST_PASS. Icarus: Q* 12/12, SPEAR 30/30. XSim: Q* 12/12, SPEAR 30/30.

OOC xc7a100t, create_clock 10.000 ns (tb/learning/ooc_synth.tcl):
  qstar_select: WNS +1.703 TNS 0.000 fail_ep 0 | LUT 2243 FF 1826 DSP 7 BRAM 0
    worst: feat_r_reg[63] -> m2_r_reg/PCIN, 6.813 ns (DSP48E1 + LUT6 + MUXF7), 3 levels
    before (your number): -10.007 on feat_r -> theta (MAC+round+add+sat one cycle)
  spear_rank:   WNS +1.898 TNS 0.000 fail_ep 0 | LUT 1390 FF 1410 DSP 1 BRAM 0
    worst: desc_r_reg[67] -> desc_ok_reg, 8.062 ns (CRC half, 10 levels, 70% route)
    before: -4.594 on desc_r -> crc16_112 combinational

WHAT CHANGED (pipeline only):
  Q*: P_RD/U_RD register theta[a][i]+feat_i before P_MAC/U_MAC (2 cyc/element); P_ROW row compare out of MAC;
      update U_DISC(rshr8 gamma*qn) -> U_TGT(sat) -> U_DELTA(clip) -> U_DA(delta*alpha once) -> {U_MUL, U_WRITE} x8.
  SPEAR: CRC16-112 as two registered 56-bit halves (S_CHECK/S_CHECK2; bit-serial CRC resumable, same value);
      S_MACRD operand stage before S_MAC; k_eff=min() registered at q_start; S_PREFIN registers boundary picks.

Expect integrated keep-hierarchy WNS != OOC. If fabric still fails on a C-owned path send Source/Destination/levels; I split further.
NOT_CLAIMED: TIMING_PASS VERIFIED NSPF-X0 BOARD_PASS FINAL_PASS.
